milestone: SeLinOS Linux syscall ABI M12 ARCH_SET_FS mapped-page TLS proof

contract.accepted_request: Only arch_prctl(code=ARCH_SET_FS 0x1002, base=the one anonymous mapped test page) is accepted.
contract.mediation: Root retains the probe TCB capability and calls seL4_TCB_SetTLSBase(probe.thread.tcb.cptr, base); the TCB capability is never delegated to the probe.
contract.probe: After zero result, the isolated probe stores and loads the fixed word TLSSELIN via fs:0 and compares it exactly.
contract.negative_scope: ARCH_GET_FS, GS base, arbitrary addresses, clone inheritance, ELF TLS relocation, dynamic linker and glibc TLS semantics are not implemented or claimed.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M12: ARCH_SET_FS mapped-page TLS base and fs:0 load/store mediated.
SeLinOS ABI M11: getdents64(FD 6) rejected with ENOTDIR; no directory service.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: restricted ARCH_SET_FS rejected.

not_claimed: ARCH_GET_FS, ARCH_SET_GS, ARCH_GET_GS or arbitrary FS base values
TCB capability delegation to Linux process domains
clone/fork TLS inheritance, ELF TLS relocations, dynamic linker or glibc compatibility
general Linux process runtime, dpkg or apt
